$comment: Framework versions ploaness owns. Every governed project declares these exactly, and the wiring gate reports any other value. They are data rather than dependencies of this package for one reason: ploaness imports none of them, and declaring them would install a second copy of Payload, Next and React into every consumer that already has one. So this file is the single place these versions are written, the way a real dependency is the single place a toolchain version is written.
$payloadFamily: Only `payload` is listed. Every `@payloadcms/*` package a project declares is required to match it, because Payload breaks at runtime when its own packages disagree. Deriving the family from `payload` rather than enumerating it means a project that adds a Payload plugin is covered without this file changing.
